note: House pool. Hand-written, no LLM text (see spec 12). Criteria live in docs/writing-questions.md: ordinary habits, unpredictable split, nothing political, medical, or about identity. Ids are stable and must never be reused for different text.

questions.text: Do you eat the pizza crust?
Have you ever gone a full day without speaking to anyone?
Do you still set a physical alarm clock?
Do you read the instructions before assembling furniture?
Do you make your bed every morning?
Do you rinse the dishes before they go in the dishwasher?
Do you know your own phone number by heart?
Do you salt your food before tasting it?
Do you wear shoes inside your home?
Do you talk to yourself when you are alone in the house?
Do you hang the toilet paper over the top?
Do you answer calls from numbers you do not recognise?
Do you leave voicemails?
Do you have a chair with clothes on it right now?
Do you watch films with the subtitles on?
Do you return the shopping trolley to the bay?
Do you press the lift button more than once?
Do you sleep with a fan on?
Do you measure ingredients or eyeball them?
Do you keep bread in the fridge?
Do you eat cereal for dinner?
Do you snooze your alarm at least once?
Do you sing in the car when someone else is in it?
Do you crack your knuckles?
Do you keep a junk drawer?
Do you close the bathroom door when you are home alone?
Do you brush your teeth before or after breakfast?
Do you finish a book you have stopped enjoying?
Do you read the last page of a book first?
Do you have more than fifty browser tabs open?
Do you use bookmarks or just search for the site again?
Do you skip the intro when you watch a series?
Do you check your phone before you get out of bed?
Do you keep your phone on silent?
Do you say hello to strangers in a lift?
Do you tell someone when they have food in their teeth?
Do you apologise to furniture you walk into?
Do you remember a name the first time you hear it?
Do you take the stairs for a single floor?
Do you walk faster when you can hear someone behind you?
Do you avoid stepping on the cracks in the pavement?
Do you take the same route home every single time?
Do you look back at your car after you have locked it?
Do you read menus outside restaurants you have no plan to enter?
Do you park front-in or reverse into the space?
Do you have files sitting on your desktop right now?
Do you rename a file after you download it?
Do you write notes by hand?
Do you keep receipts you will never need again?
Do you reread a message after you have already sent it?
Do you keep browser tabs open as a to-do list?
Do you own something you have never once used?
Do you keep the box a device came in?
Do you have a drawer of cables you cannot identify?
Do you leave the television on for background noise?
Do you sort laundry by colour before washing it?
Do you fold the laundry the same day you wash it?
Do you use the top sheet on your bed?
Do you wear socks to bed?
Do you sleep with the window open or closed?
Do you sing in the shower?
Do you wear a watch every day?
Do you own a pair of shoes you have never worn?
Do you cut your own hair?
Do you remember your dreams?
Do you keep coins in a jar?
Do you still carry cash?
Do you buy the extended warranty?
Do you check the receipt before you leave the shop?
Do you have a subscription you forgot you were paying for?
Do you buy books faster than you read them?
Do you replace something before it has fully broken?
Do you have a favourite mug?
Do you drink water straight from the tap?
Do you eat leftovers cold from the container?
Do you drink the milk left at the bottom of the cereal bowl?
Do you cut a sandwich into triangles or rectangles?
Do you eat pizza with a fork?
Do you order the same thing every time at your regular place?
Do you finish a restaurant meal you are not enjoying?
Do you double dip when nobody is watching?
Do you keep a running grocery list?
Do you take a shopping list and then ignore it?
Do you butter toast all the way to the edges?
Do you rehearse a phone call before you make it?
Do you reply to a message the moment you read it?
Do you have unread messages sitting on your phone right now?
Do you read a group chat every day without ever replying?
Do you send voice notes?
Do you feel relieved when plans are cancelled?
Do you introduce yourself first at a party?
Do you still speak to anyone from primary school?
Do you pretend to be on the phone to avoid someone?
Do you hold a door for someone who is still a long way off?
Do you say sorry when somebody else bumps into you?
Do you listen to podcasts faster than normal speed?
Do you rewatch a series you have already finished?
Do you scroll or search when you open a streaming app?
Do you set the volume to an even number?
Do you close the apps running in the background?
Do you take photos you will never look at again?
Do you delete apps you have not opened in a year?
Do you have an unread email count above a thousand?
Do you charge your phone overnight?
Do you name your devices something other than the default?
Do you read the comments before you read the article?
Do you keep a physical diary or planner?
Do you use the calendar on your phone?
Do you check your bank balance more than once a week?
Do you arrive early and then sit outside waiting?
Do you set an alarm for something less than an hour away?
Do you count the steps as you climb them?
Do you own a plunger?
Do you dust before you vacuum?
Do you know where your birth certificate is?
Do you keep plants alive for more than a year?
Do you take the window seat or the aisle?
Do you carry a reusable bag and then forget to bring it in?
Do you sleep on your side?
Do you use a case on your phone?
Do you peel the label off a bottle while you talk?
Do you keep the receipt in the bag until you get home?
Do you wash a cup before you use it even when it is clean?
Do you eat the last piece of something in a shared bowl?
Do you look at the tissue after you blow your nose?
Do you skip past a song you actually like?
Do you reread the same page after your mind wanders?
Do you keep a to-do list that you actually finish?
Do you turn the radio down to find an address?
Do you check that the door is locked twice?
